---
title: The language switcher changes the whole page and keeps the place
priority: P1
tags: [eval]
device: [iphone, win-chrome]
---
## Steps

1. Open /upgrade.
   Expect: the plans page in the cell's locale.
2. Switch the language to Italian with the language switcher (on a phone through the menu).
   Expect: /it/upgrade; headings, plan names, prices and buttons in Italian, nothing left in the previous language.
3. Switch back to the cell's locale.
   Expect: the plans page again in the cell's locale.
